_comment:
"Attacks that target you this turn get -1{p}. If a CHI WAS PITCHED to play this, effects don't trigger if an attack hits you this turn."

Clause 1 was a plain STATIC -- which nothing dispatches -- holding MODIFY_ATTACK_POWER_PER_UNIQUE_AURA, an effect that counts distinct AURA NAMES in the arena, with an invented aura_type. MODIFY_ATTACKS_THIS_TURN already says exactly this: it queues a turn-scoped per-attack hook on a player and _apply_turn_attack_effects reads the hook off the ATTACKING player, so putting it on the OPPONENT is "attacks that target you".

Clause 2 was an ON_PITCH trigger setting a private flag plus an ON_DEFEND ability granting WARD. WARD is damage PREVENTION, not trigger suppression, so the card was given a shield it does not have while the clause it does have went unimplemented; and the pitch gate was REF_PITCH_IS ref:"CHI", which tests a referenced card's pitch COLOUR. Suppression is now a flag read at the single ON_HIT dispatch point -- the damage still happens, only the triggered layers are suppressed -- and "pitched to play THIS" is answerable because play._pitch_for_cost stamps the cards it took onto the card being played.
